description: Competition persists but institutions and communication reduce systemic escalation risk.
Security technology trade finance and information systems harden into competing blocs.
Regional crises multiply while institutions weaken and crisis coordination becomes selective.
Technology rivalry shapes cyber conflict AI competition semiconductor controls and information instability.
Climate shocks intensify food water migration infrastructure and regional security pressures.
Regions build practical resilience while global order remains contested.
Institutions reform around representation accountability communication and shared risk governance.
Restraint mechanisms fail across military economic technological environmental and institutional domains.
